Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of lower back pain and muscle tightness.
The reported mechanism of injruy is consistent with the kind and force of the crash. Over the course of 23 visits, care consisted of
manual therapy, guided stretching, home exercise instruction, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication, following a typical
recovery pathway. Visit frequency was reduced progressively as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. Physical
examination showed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar flexion, which support the reported strain, while
neurological screening, reflexes, and straight-leg raise testing were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the
lumbar region is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single charges for each service with no duplicate or repeated
billing. The patient is expected to continue a self-directed exercise program and reutrn only if symptoms recur.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
